comments.body:
Closing in favor of #2257, which fixes the same issue (#2249).

Keeping the first copy of a shared name has two problems:

- "First" depends on which server finishes connecting first. The servers connect in parallel and `registry.ts:93` adds each client once its `connect()` resolves, so the description and schema the model sees can change from one run to the next.
- The `execute` in `index.ts:181` calls `registry.executeTool` without a `serverName`, and `registry.ts:401-412` falls through to the next server on any error, including the 60s timeout. A call that timed out on server A runs again on server B, with args built for A's schema. For a tool that writes, that can mean a duplicate side effect in another system.

That also means a third-party server exposing `KODUS_FIND_MEMORIES` that connects faster would silently take those calls. #2257 drops only the ambiguous name and logs it, which avoids all of the above.
